dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle region.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetrical indentation visible on the right lateral margin near the mid-body.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high-intensity reflectance across the primary dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, faint greyish-tan mottling concentrated toward the posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, soft-edged gradients between the white baseline and the darker posterior patches.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple faint, linear, light-grey rake marks visible across the mid-dorsal and posterior regions.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Distinct longitudinal groove/indentation running along the central dorsal axis toward the posterior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive network of shallow, linear rake marks (scratches) distributed across the dorsal surface.
